description: Each media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds; list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, with the rate and how far above it is.

c.request: Which media types (by name, counting only tracks that have a media type) have a bytes-per-millisecond rate higher than the simple average of that rate across all media types? For each, show the media type name, its rate, and how much it exceeds that average, unrounded. Each media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds; list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, with the rate and how far above it is.
c.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate AS bytes_per_millisecond, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS excess_over_average FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC

b.request: Compute each media type's rate as its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds, using only tracks that have a media type, then list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, showing the media type name, the rate, and the unrounded amount by which the rate exceeds that mean
b.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS excess FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) ORDER BY rate DESC

a.request: For each media type (grouped by name, using only tracks that are linked to a media type), compute its byte rate as the media type's total `Bytes` divided by its total `Milliseconds`. Then take the simple average of these rates across all media types. Which media types have a rate above that overall average? For each, give the media type name, its rate, and how far it is above the overall average (rate minus average), without rounding.
a.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_r FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_r AS difference_above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_r ORDER BY r.rate DESC

d.request: Among tracks that have a media type, compute each media type's rate as its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds. Which media types (by name) have a rate higher than the unweighted mean of all media types' rates (the simple average of the per-media-type rates, not weighted by track count)? For each, show the media type name, its rate, and how far it exceeds that mean, all unrounded.
d.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - a.mean_rate AS excess FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.mean_rate
